Your schedule should leave room for your own ambitions, Taurus, and this is a promising time to create that balance.

The Scorpio New Moon on November 9th activates your productivity and wellness realm, launching a six-month chapter of professional and lifestyle improvements. You may feel inspired to transition into a new role, develop a specialized skill, or explore technology that could make your work more efficient. With Mars in Leo energizing your communication and learning zone, opportunities involving writing, teaching, marketing, or digital media could be especially appealing. Think about what your ideal workday would look like and which changes could bring you closer to experiencing it.

On November 13th, your ruling planet Mercury finally ends its retrograde in Scorpio, helping you move forward with job applications, workplace negotiations, or projects that have been stuck in revision mode. You may receive useful feedback from a supervisor or discover a more effective way to manage your responsibilities. Meanwhile, Venus direct in Libra brings a refreshing boost to your creativity, pleasure, and self-expression zone. A hobby or artistic project you’ve neglected could suddenly feel exciting again, and you may even discover an opportunity to share it with a wider audience. There’s room for both professional success and personal enjoyment in your next chapter, Gemini. Make space for both.

Cancer Sun & Rising:

Whether you’ve been considering launching a passion project, sharing your work publicly, or turning a hobby into a business, this lunation encourages you to take your gifts seriously. The Scorpio New Moon on November 9th activates your communication, writing, and learning realm, opening a six-month chapter of intellectual growth. Perhaps you’re ready to launch a newsletter, start a podcast, learn a language, or develop an expertise that could open professional doors. On November 13th, your ruling planet Mercury ends its retrograde in Scorpio, helping you move forward with submissions, presentations, contracts, or educational plans that have required multiple revisions. You may finally feel ready to send something out into the world after weeks of fine-tuning it. Meanwhile, Venus direct in Libra brings welcome clarity to your finances and earning potential. If you’ve been reconsidering your pricing, negotiating payment, or evaluating the financial value of a skill, you could feel better equipped to advocate for yourself. Your knowledge has value, and the second half of November is a good time to start treating it that way.

Libra Sun & Rising:

Libra, what if the next six months completely transformed your relationship with money and your sense of self-worth? The Scorpio New Moon on November 9th activates your income, security, and abundance zone, encouraging you to set intentions around the kind of financial freedom you want to create. With Mars in Leo energizing your friendship and future-goals realm, a collaboration or connection within your network could help you see new possibilities for building wealth. Think about what you want your financial life to look like by next spring, including how much you want to earn, save, or invest. The more specific you get about your goals, the easier it’ll be to recognize opportunities that can help you achieve them.

Then November 13th brings a major turning point as your ruling planet Venus finally ends its retrograde in your sign, alongside Mercury ending its retrograde in Scorpio. If the past several weeks have felt like one long identity crisis, you may be more than ready to come up for air! Venus direct can help restore your confidence in your appearance, relationships, and personal direction, especially if you’ve been questioning decisions you once felt certain about. Meanwhile, Mercury direct in your financial realm could bring clarity to delayed payments, negotiations, or important money conversations. Give yourself credit for the ways you’ve grown through this retrograde season, Libra. You’re entering the second half of November with a stronger sense of who you are and what you’re worth.

Scorpio Sun & Rising:

Scorpio, your solar return season’s getting increasingly better. Your annual New Moon arrives on November 9th, and this one has “fresh start” written all over it.
